I like South Indian food, and I am quite impressed about Saravana Bhavan food chain due to their authentic taste of various South Indian dishes, which I have tried quite a few times during my visits to Chennai, Kanchipuram, etc. So, this time when I made a visit to Chennai and checked-in a hotel at Club House Road, I became very happy to note that there was an outlet of Saravana Bhavan at Spencer Plaza, within walking distance. On the first evening, I, along with my two colleagues, went there at around 9:15 pm, which is an ideal time for dinner. We were surprised that it was closed, though it was supposed to be open till 10:00 pm. So, we managed our dinner somewhere else, and went there again on the next day evening at around 8:40 pm. Even at that time, the outlet was half closed, and they allowed us to enter and sit inside with such an attitude as if they were doing a great favour to us. Anyway, we ordered some dishes. After a long wait, they served in such a manner that I had to finish the dinner by the time the food was just served to one of my colleagues. This was ridiculous. There was a definite deterioration of taste this time. In last week of April, it was a very hot weather, but they had already switched off the AC, and we had to manage our dinner in an intolerable ambience, sweating like anything. There was no water for washing hands. Price of food is exorbitant. A simple normal size paratha costs more than Rs. 70 !!! Finally, when I went to their counter for paying the bill through their UPI QR code, they started demanding tips even before had I made the payment. It was such an irritating experience this time !! I do not know if it is specific for this branch or it is an overall deterioration of this food chain, but next time I will think several times before entering any of the outlets of Saravana Bhavan.

Indian Cuisine is as diverse as its culture, languages, regions and its climate. Every major region of India brings its own unique dishes and subtle variations to popular dishes. Aromatic Spices are the essence of Indian cuisine. This is the unique formula at Hotel Saravana Bhavan, chain of  Indian vegetarian restaurants follow, to build their businesses across the globe. Hotel Saravana Bhavan is one of the largest vegetarian restaurant chains in the world, founded in 1981, and specialising in South Indian Vegetarian cuisine. Each new restaurant added to their network carries the legacy of good taste and quality. The trust that the customers have placed in the group of hotels has been a motivating factor in exploring new destinations. Today, the group has its presence across 30 outlets in South India (with 20 outlets in Chennai itself), 3 in the North and in 18 countries, with 80 outlets all across the globe. They have come a long way in creating a niche among the Hotels and Catering segment. They ensure that their customers are their strength and make them feel at home. One can eat in, take-away, or have it catered for you. The feeling is friendly and the food is fabulous. Whenever you need it, wherever you need it, it is your own unique world to eat. Their services include Fast Food, Take Away, Home Delivery, Outdoor Catering, Party Orders, etc. Until the 1970’s, there were very few restaurants in Chennai. In 1968, Shri Rajagopalan, the owner, opened a tiny grocery shop on the outskirts of the city. Shri Rajagopalan’s vision and a keen desire to take his concept worldwide was a gradual process. By the 1990s, the Saravana Bhavan chain of restaurants spread throughout neighbourhoods in Chennai. In the year 2000, Saravana Bhavan opened its first overseas branch, by inaugurating a restaurant in Dubai, which has a large population of Indian expatriates. We, as a family, recently visited Hotel Saravana Bhavan’s Anna Nagar branch for brunch. They serve a variety of great vegetarian dishes, South and North Indian and also Chinese (Indian version). The ambience is good and their service is quick. We had a variety of South Indian breakfast, which was well prepared and tasted delicious. Their filter coffee is excellent!

The food was okay. Need to wait a long time to get noticed by the servers.Overall not a pleasant experience.
Had such a nice meal here! Great atmosphere and very affordable. Also near a market that we bought small gifts for friends at. Would definitely recommend this restaurant!
its good for south indian food, one main plus is one looking for south indian meals in the night this one of the few venue....

About a decade back, while being in Chennai the first thought for food was always Saravana Bhavan Restaurant. But recently I discovered at Pondy Bazar restaurant that old charm has gone. It was quite disappointing being there !!

The Class of the food has come down these days. More than the quality of the food which has come down the attitude of the staff there is totally degrading nowadays. The two plus points of Saravana bhavan was food and service, which is now in question mark?
Pretty cheap and does the job.

The food here is fine. But some branches do not provide good service. Only a few I mean. Two or three. But otherwise this hotel provides awesome cultural food which is tasty. This food will surely be loved by those who are cultural food lovers. Dosa, Idly, Vada, and everything, WOW!!!! Delicious!!!!

The vegetarian food at the Saravana Bhavan is one of the best I have had so far especially the thali and every time I go to Chennai I make it a must to go there to have food .I am not the only one but my whole family enjoy the Saravana Bhavan food.
Though this hotel is not appropriate for this title the juices savored here were very rich in taste and quality,the fruits chosen was very fresh & more juicy

Tamil food for pure vegetarian people can have it with full enjoyment and thts also unlimited. They serve food in banana leaf with full traditional style... the awesome food item is curd rice.. price are also too reasonable
Nowadays this hotel becoming worse day by day.Had a mini meal here and decided never to come back here again.
Very bad customer service. Please think twice before visiting the hotel. When you can wait for longer period.

This restaurant has had good times and now it's limiting in its age old glory which is neither relevant or wanted now. Only their age old customers are visiting it and it has failed to re-invent itself

The original Saravanabhavan taste is maintained only in a few joints and this is one of them. Idli with killer sambar is always a treat and starter. Ghee onion Rava roast (Dosa) with coffee made me a happy and content person! Will go again if in this area.
It was a sumptuous lunch I had in this restaurant with my lion friends.Quantity is more than sufficient. Could eat authentic Tamil Nadu good.

True to the reputation of the name, this particular establishment also served delectable food. We took poori bhanu, rava masala,pulka,pong al all very tasty.filter coffee was out of the world. The service however while good , can be much better.

Old saravanabhavan standards gone.I been many times during my visit to chennai. Price are hike, specially I had one Kadai paneer...it was expensive, they charged 340 plus tax...I hope in star note charges will be like this.. Taste was OK...
it's totally veg so pls don't forget about... my best was limited veg meals, might be you will satisfied about if you choose as well as variety of tifine items are there
the worst service and worst food, HSB service, goodwill everything gone. the management has to take immediate step to develop further. Since HSB is TN trademark

SB has surely fallen from its high standards. The ambience, the torn furniture, the lack of crowds, are all proof of the fall. Never again.

Visting saravana is like visting the place which serve best of the south Indian delicacies. For me this place is a comfort food place. Where you can feel so relax and enjoy your food. They have variety of south indian dishes. If you are a food lover than you should certain go to this place. This place even do hoe delivery.

It was a November evening when my friends and I walked into the hotel.The ambience was perfect ,clean and hygienic.We ordered our food items looking at the Menu card.I loved their appamwith milk combination It was so tasty that I ordered another set ,as it was irresistible.My friends too ordered their Dahi vada,Rava dosa and they were all tasty and delicious.I recommend everyone to visit saravana Bhavan atleast once in 15 days.
Just awesome food! Finger lickin good! The spreads have a large range and served hot and quick! If you are into south indian, not to be missed
Not presently a good place to visit . Attitude of the staffs have changed as well the taste and quality of food . Many items are missing
If you need a best thali South Indian food this is the best place to our football enjoy mini meals it I love it
Now a days service of this hotel chain is not so good....it's taste n service is declining as per my opinion...cost was high but taste was average...ordered meals which was waste of money....

Went there for lunch. The server mentioned only mini meals, even though there were other items available. The mini meals was just ok. Paid by card. i got the SMS for the debit, but the machine did not print the receipt. They made me pay again (they insisted on cash, but I paid using UPI). They had no clue that there was something called a UPI payment (they were insisting on phonepe). Hopefully, my bank will reverse the credit card transaction.
My friend and I shared 2 two thalia and I left uncomfortably full because I could not stop myself from eating the great food!

If you are in Chennai and you miss your visit to Sarvana bhavan for your breakfast. Lunch. Dinner then your trip is not complete because it's on of the best in entire south India o  terms of typical south Indian food all the items on menus is superp...

Has decent vegetarian menu. Particularly South Indian dishes are very good. Had Masala dosa,Idlis and a cup of tea. Taste of Masala dosa is authentic. Service is reasonable. Ambience could have been better.Busy restaurant
Decent place to sit and eat, with authentic chennai style dining on banana leaf with tasty food .. but expensive
It is a very good veg restaurant .we had idli sambhar and vada which was nice . Even the waiters are very customers friendly and guide you if you have any query .
Very very worst for staff behaviour also. All the foods are serviced chilled one, but responsible to take care of the guest

The vegetarian lunch served is very spicy and exhorbitantly priced.Quality of the food items has come down drastically.The arrogant servers and the supervisors in safari are of little help to you.They live on past glory.Very unpleasant experience in most of the outlets

The service was pathetic and we had to wait inordinately to be served a normal lunch. The wrong order was initially served. Had to wait for the bill for almost 15 minutes and after prodding for quite some time finally managed to get the same.

In the evening of 17th September, 2019 we went to Sarvana bhavan in Egmore Chennai for taking snacks. i had an extremely bad impression about the cleanliness of such restaurant. I had the misfortune of going to their restroom which I found extremely dirty and unclean and the floor was flooded with water. Whatever, tasty food they serve I have a doubt if their kitchen is properly maintained. Indian food and safety department should check whether food preparation is hygienic. In February, 2019 I visited another branch of them and it was not in good shape. They perhaps think only about profit nothing else about their customers.

We went to the saravana bhavan located at ekkattuthangal near by Jaya TV office It was totally cordless and we asked for dosa and coffee. Dosa was some what better and sambar wasn't good. Coffee served without hot. It got cooled by the time we started to drink Overall not happy
The quality and flavours fell short of our expectations on this recent trip to Chennai.  It was overcrowded, undermanned and the food quality has fallen below expectations.
Here we can have a good lunch that to no spicy, the taste is authentic Saravana Bhavan same taste with a neat and clean environment, People who do not like spicy food can go without any thought.
Excellent lunch and enjoyed local waybif eating in banana leaves. It's clean and nice place with quick service
As I was traveling by myself I asked my driver to stop at a decent vegetarian restaurant for lunch. The service was great. Food had a welcome variety. Loved it all. I’d go back again.

Thinking about the brand name Saravana Bhavan, we went for lunch and ended up having the worst food ever. The place is not well maintained and no hygiene at all. The food served was not even fresh and hot. "Saravan Bhavan has lost its quality in food"

But the garish yellow plastic plates , grime settled in corners etc is very offputting. Avoid . The food is mediocre too .
Nothing great but just your average vegetarian franchise outlet.Not all the food are fresh at all the times so you have be savvy when placing orders.

I ate here practically everyday for the several months i was assigned to work in Chennai. What a bargain for a lot of very good food. I would have a Thali most days for lunch and very filling, fresh food with a generous portion of some good rice. They do have some locations in the States but sadly, not yet in Phoenix. Cannot beat the price and value of Saravana Bhavan!
We loved the ghee roast dosa there. Other items like medu vada sambar, mini idlis, uttapam were good too. And last but not the least filter coffee!! :) :)

We had breakfast and one night dinner here. Food is good. But of late service is becoming little slow. May be the staff were in mourning after the demise of its owner recently. They have the same chain of restaurants world wide like in USA, UK, FRANCE  GERMANY, AUSTRALIA,  MIDDLE EAST.
Unique taste of Vegetarian.. Varieties of food with good & very fast service..Dynamic waiters with Smile..!!!
Delicious Dosai Chutney Poodi but the highlight was the delicious Sarmbar 👌👌👌 Absolutely delicious Top marks 10 out of 10
